objective_preparation.scope: Only the four derived objective observation coordinates may change during preparation

execution.convergence_evidence: One source count and one integration step; not a convergence demonstration
execution.scope: Frozen clipped nominal; original-source classical vacuum optical transport only

receipt.gun_observation_dispatch: Production trace_feg_with_observations with original bound magnetic environment

numerical_definitions.position: Current-weighted centroid: rRMS=sqrt(sum(p_i*|r_i-rbar|^2)); D95=2*weighted_quantile_95(|r_i-rbar|). Diameter is not radius.
numerical_definitions.angle: u_i=(tx,ty,1)/norm; uc=normalized sum(p_i*u_i); theta_i=atan2(|u_i cross uc|,u_i dot uc); alphaRMS=sqrt(sum(p_i*theta_i^2)); alpha95=current-weighted quantile of theta.
numerical_definitions.slope: Stored tx_rad/ty_rad are mechanical slopes dx/dz and dy/dz; reported angular radii use true 3D direction angles, not slope magnitudes.
numerical_definitions.angular_interpretation: Unsigned mechanical angular spread relative to the weighted chief direction, including rotational/tangential motion in magnetic fields. The angle alone does not prove convergence; position-slope covariance signs distinguish convergence from divergence. No equal-angle requirement is imposed.
numerical_definitions.axis: Mechanical Z-axis radius=hypot(x,y), angle=atan2(hypot(tx,ty),1). Axis diagnostics are separate from centroid/chief-relative spread.
numerical_definitions.quantile: First sorted sample reaching the requested cumulative original-current fraction; no interpolation and no outlier pruning.
numerical_definitions.current: Each actual-plane percentage uses the current reaching that plane; original source current and original weights separately supply absolute transmission.
numerical_definitions.common: Same original IDs surviving every saved column plane, with unchanged original weights. This is supplementary and never replaces an upstream actual population.
numerical_definitions.tail: RMS is tail sensitive. D95/alpha95 can omit outer <5% current from their boundary, but those particles still influence centroid/chief. Maxima are sampled maxima, never physical pupil edges.
numerical_definitions.focus: Finite 2D RMS regions and native sampled D95 minima are separate. No covariance free-drift offset or quadratic RMS focus is used as native D95 focus.

common_population_note: The same 647 original IDs and weights survive all captured column planes; actual and common statistics coincide.

angular_ratios.role: Observed angular magnification only; no equal-angle acceptance constraint

focus_candidates.comparison_band_role: Descriptive near-degeneracy screen only, never an acceptance threshold
focus_candidates.interpretation: The smallest observed D95 among this finite sample is not a demonstrated unique stable physical focus. Weighted order-statistic membership may change between adjacent planes; no smooth-focus interpolation or RMS substitution is made. Increased source-count and integration-step checks remain separate.

trapezoidal_position_slope_consistency.scope: Actual adjacent observation planes; field curvature and sampling contribute. This is not a free-drift propagation or an integration-error acceptance test.

launch_energy_reconstruction.scope: Deterministic production emitter sampling only. Saved emission ray IDs, positions, directions, normals and original weights must be bitwise equal before launch energies are emitted.

native_local_continuity.scope: Offline adjacent native observations only. Trapezoidal position-slope residual includes field curvature and sampling; it does not establish integration convergence.

limitations: One source count and one column step; no numerical-convergence qualification.
The prepared 0.1 mm comparison passed preparation checks but was not propagated.
Gun observations near C1 are native; sparse interpolated gun display histories do not qualify gun crossover topology.
Finite 2D covariance waists are not by themselves proof of sharp source-image conjugacy or scan pivots.
No source deletion, reweighting, lens retuning, source-law change, coherent calculation or scan was performed.
